failure_sample_warning: Only 6 failed executions were observed among 720 known outcomes. This is a very small failure sample. Failure-group comparisons and correlations are exploratory and should not support strong statistical conclusions.
correlation_interpretation: Pearson and Spearman correlations are descriptive exploratory associations. Their ordinary p-values assume independent observations and are not treated as valid inferential evidence because executions are clustered within tasks.
